items.title: McNeal Breaux Interview, 1958-11-24
items.q: Joe Snye and myself, we lied about our age to go to the entertainers and watch Bucket play drum.

ctx.x: anything at that time. And you were a little young to go out and hear those times.

No, I do remember, uh, Joe Snye and myself, we lied about our age to go to the entertainers and watch Bucket play drum. He was a wonderful drummer. Pity to him. Yeah, he had a lot of novelty with him, you know, stick tricks and all that kind of stuff. And then, uh, we had to go to the entertainers and watch Bucket play drum. He was a wonderful drummer.
